title: Aethelix Causal DAG Schema
description: Strict JSON Schema for validating Aethelix YAML/JSON satellite causal DAG configuration files. See docs/yaml_dag_schema.md for the full specification.

aethelix_dag_version.description: Schema version this file targets. Major-version mismatch raises DAGLoadError; minor-version mismatch emits a warning.

satellite.description: Free-form metadata block describing the satellite. Not used by the inference engine — purely for documentation and provenance.

failure_date.description: ISO-8601 date of the failure event

nodes.description: Ordered list of node objects. Each node is a vertex in the DAG representing a fault, an intermediate physical effect, or an observable telemetry reading.

id.description: Unique identifier for this node. No spaces allowed; use underscores.

type.description: Functional role of the node in the causal model.

description.description: Human-readable label shown in reports and graph visualisations.

degradation_modes.description: Specific physical failure modes for this node. Primarily applicable to root_cause nodes.

subsystem.description: Optional grouping label (e.g. 'EPS', 'ADCS', 'COMMS') used by visualisers to colour-code nodes.

structural_equation.description: Optional linear-Gaussian SCM parameters for causal effect estimation.

expected_evidence.description: Optional mapping of root cause ID to list of observable IDs expected to trigger.

edges.description: List of directed causal edge objects. Each edge represents 'failures in source cause effects in target'.

source.description: id of the source (cause) node. Must be declared in nodes.

target.description: id of the target (effect) node. Must be declared in nodes.

weight.description: Strength of the causal relationship. 1.0 = deterministic; 0.5 = moderate; 0.0 = no effect.

mechanism.description: Natural-language explanation of the physical mechanism. Shown in operator reports alongside the root-cause hypothesis.
